planets.name: TOI-261 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-261 with a 3.36-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-261 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-261. Its orbit and size follow Hord et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
